title: Git merge: the same tips can produce a different result

omissions.reason: The compact source cue pins Git 2.55 but omits the release-discovery audit.
Focus is the net-change consequence, not revert command options.
Merge-commit reversion requires a separate ancestry explanation; not compressed into this comparison plate.
Reset modes are outside this single ordinary-file comparison.
Plate explicitly limits itself to ort three-way merging, without presenting strategy options as fixes.
